description: Phase 0 spike inputs: the job_tracker PR commits behind each must_catch entry in ../fixtures/job_tracker_regressions.json. baseSha is the PR's base commit (from the GitHub PR API); headSha is the PR head. The Go directive override is a spike-only workaround: job_tracker's go.mod asks for go 1.26.1 and the local toolchain is 1.24.7 (toolchain download is blocked here), applied identically to head and base.
